title: Kourovka 10.34: manuscript, formal developments, certificates, and reproducibility materials
description:
Exact reproducibility archive for a proof that every finite group that is the product of every pair of its non-conjugate maximal subgroups is soluble. The archive contains the 26-page manuscript, partial Lean and Rocq formalizations, a neutral Comparator interface, GAP certificates, independent Python checks, source maps, and pinned computational inputs.

The main theorem is proved by ordinary mathematics relative to the cited classification and subgroup-theoretic inputs; the formal developments provide partial rather than end-to-end coverage.
